title: 第3章 活该第4 折腾第5章 人心
slug: 玄幻我有机甲鬼才愿意去修仙
content_zh:
当太阳的第一缕阳光刺破黑暗的时候，老刘慵懒地打开城门，看着行色匆匆的行人，不禁打起了哈欠。
“老刘，你儿子去剑血宗，怎么样了？”
旁边一个矮个子靠着城墙，聊了起来。
正说着，一队马车缓缓驶入城内，每辆车都是用八匹马拉着，车上的空间足够装下三十个壮汉。
奇怪的是车上的货物却只有一半米高、却被黑布紧紧包裹的柱子状的东西。
老刘一看立马察觉不对劲，招呼其他人将车队拦下，他握紧刀柄慢悠悠地上前检查。
刚走到车头，一个瘦弱的驼背老头就笑眯眯将锭五两纹银塞了过去。
老刘看了一眼银子，立马把推了回去。
老头又摸出三个同样大小的银子。
老刘阴沉的脸上这才露出些许的笑容，退到一旁，挥手让其他人放行。
不远处的矮个子城守像事不关己似地，自顾自地从腰间拔出烟杆捣鼓起来，嘴里嘟囔了起来。
“世道啊，世道。”
老刘揣着银子走到他身边，看着一辆辆大车徐徐而过，眉头紧锁。
“这批货有问题。”
旁边几个年轻城守们围拢过来，好奇地询问：“头，车子有什么问题？”
矮个子瞥了一眼马车，哼了一声，“你们看那车重的都把青石压碎了。”
众人回头看去，果然，车碾过的地方，青石都碎成了无数小块。
车队有序的缓缓驶入，好不容易最后一辆车入了城，退至一旁的行人刚要回到路上。
一个脸部肿胀的比猪头还大的老头迈着大步走入，其身上还散发着阵阵恶臭，引得行人赶紧捂住口鼻。
“这老小子脸怎么那么肿？”

“准是调戏小姑娘，被人打的，哈哈哈......”
“对，一定是，这老小子看起来就不像好人。”
......
守在门口城守们也注意到这个奇怪的老头，一个细眼城守刚要上前，就被老刘一把拉住。
“这老头身上一丝灵力波动都没有，别去管他。”
细眼城守闻到那股臭味，胃里一阵翻江倒海。
“挣那几两碎银子，不要多管闲事。”
矮个子附和着，目光转向消失在视线里的车队，嘴角掠过了一丝冷笑。
而此时的石泉水，丝毫没理会旁人的指指点点，只是苦涩地笑了笑。
“创口贴连骨裂疼都能缓减，怎么却对萝莉的敲打后的淤伤丝毫没有作用，贴上却反而疼痛加剧了？”
他嘟囔着，还有件事更加想不明白。
按道理，挨打后，哪怕挨一下才一点积分，这一晚上下来，好歹也只有几千积分了。
但是——
“居然每天最多给萝莉打五十下，而且每次被她打的获得的积分是随机的，但超过五十下，积分绝对会变成负数。”
“挨了一晚上打，没挣到一分钱，反而欠了一屁股债，幸好我聪明先兑换了五十两银子，不然这几天都得饿肚子了。”
一想起银子，石泉水的心情好了许多。
在这个世界，五十两对一般人而言，一辈子都未必能攒下。
他现在有了银子，怎么也能吃几天好吃的了。
想到这，他不由得摸向怀里的钱袋子。
“银子呢？银子刚刚明明在钱袋里，钱袋还在，银子却不见了？”

“苍天啊！”
他身上的机甲虽然是0号，可一旦穿上，就能给予他诸多的属性加持，比如敏锐的感知力。
content_en:
When the first ray of the sun pierced the darkness, Old Liu lazily opened the city gate, looked at the hurried pedestrians, and couldn't help but yawn.
"Old Liu, how is your son going to the Sword and Blood Sect?"
A short man next to him was leaning against the city wall and started chatting.
Just as he was talking, a group of carriages slowly drove into the city. Each carriage was pulled by eight horses. The space on the carriage was enough to hold thirty strong men.
The strange thing is that the cargo on the car is only half a meter high, but it is a pillar-like thing tightly wrapped in black cloth.
As soon as Lao Liu saw it, he immediately noticed something was wrong and called others to stop the convoy. He gripped the handle of the knife and slowly stepped forward to check.
As soon as he walked to the front of the car, a thin old man with a hunchback smiled and stuffed five taels of silver ingots into it.
Old Liu took one look at the silver and immediately pushed it back.
The old man took out three more pieces of silver of the same size.
Only then did a slight smile appear on Lao Liu's gloomy face. He stepped aside and waved for others to let them go.
The short city guard not far away, as if the matter had nothing to do with him, took out the pipe from his waist and began to tinker with it, muttering in his mouth.
"The way of the world, the way of the world."
Old Liu walked to him with the money in his pocket, frowning as he watched the large cars passing by slowly.
"There's something wrong with this shipment."
Several young city guards gathered around and asked curiously: "Boss, what's wrong with the car?"
The short man glanced at the carriage and snorted, "You see, the weight of the carriage crushed the bluestone."
Everyone looked back, and sure enough, where the car ran over, the bluestone was broken into countless small pieces.
The convoy drove in slowly and orderly, and finally the last car entered the city. The pedestrians who retreated to the side were just about to return to the road.
An old man with a swollen face larger than a pig's head strode in. His body was still exuding a stench, causing passers-by to quickly cover their mouths and noses.
"Why is this old boy's face so swollen?"
"I must have teased the little girl and got beaten, hahaha..."
"Yes, it must be, this old boy doesn't look like a good person."
...
The city guards guarding the door also noticed this strange old man. Just as the narrow-eyed city guard was about to step forward, he was grabbed by Old Liu.
"This old man doesn't have any spiritual power fluctuations on his body, so don't worry about him."
The narrow-eyed city guard smelled the stench, and his stomach turned upside down.
"Earn those few taels of silver and don't meddle in other people's business."
The short man agreed, turning his eyes to the motorcade that had disappeared from sight, and a sneer flashed across his lips.
At this time, Shi Quanshui didn't pay any attention to other people's pointing, and just smiled bitterly.
"The Band-Aid can even relieve the pain of bone fractures, but why does it have no effect on Loli's bruises after being beaten, but the pain worsens when it is applied?"
He muttered, and there was something he couldn't figure out even more.
It stands to reason that after being beaten, even if you only get a few points after being beaten, you will only have a few thousand points at the end of the night.
But——
"I can actually hit Loli up to fifty times a day, and the points I get every time I get hit by her are random, but if I hit her more than fifty times, my points will definitely become negative."
"I was beaten all night, and I didn't earn a penny. Instead, I owed a lot of debt. Fortunately, I was smart and exchanged fifty taels of silver first, otherwise I would have been hungry for the past few days."
Shi Quanshui felt much better when he thought of Yin Zi.
In this world, ordinary people may not be able to save fifty taels in a lifetime.
Now that he has money, he can eat delicious food for a few days.
Thinking of this, he couldn't help but touch the money bag in his arms.
"Where's the money? The money was clearly in the purse just now, but the purse is still there, but the money is gone?"
"Oh my God!"
Although the mecha he wears is size 0, once he puts it on, it can give him many attribute blessings, such as keen perception.
